_meta.purpose: AI-curated subdomain-takeover signatures for the Network module dns_subdomain_takeover_check probe.
_meta.source: Distilled from the can-i-take-over-xyz body of knowledge (EdOverflow) + provider docs. Each entry is a takeover-prone third-party service.
_meta.matching_contract: ZERO-FP. A finding requires BOTH (1) the host CNAME contains one of the entry's 'suffixes' (CNAME-confirmation) AND (2) the entry's 'fingerprint' (lowercased) is a substring of the lowercased HTTP body of the host. Generic strings ('404', 'not found', 'error') are FORBIDDEN as fingerprints.

confidence_values.confirmed: Takeover reproducibly possible; specific unclaimed-resource fingerprint is reliable.
confidence_values.edge: Takeover is conditional / partially fixed by the provider / requires extra steps. Treat cautiously; fingerprint may match a transient state.

_meta.fingerprint_case: Stored lowercase to match the scanner which lowercases the response body.
